description.zh: 让 Amadeus 听见你。Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 本地识别模型，将语音输入转为文字。
description.en: Let Amadeus hear you. The local Qwen3-ASR 0.6B model turns spoken input into text.

detail.zh: 本地识别 · 需匹配本地模型依赖
detail.en: Local ASR · Requires local model dependencies

description.zh: 让文字成为声音。包含 GPT-SoVITS v3 运行权重与参考音频，用于本地语音合成。
description.en: Give words a voice. GPT-SoVITS v3 runtime weights and reference audio for local speech synthesis.

detail.zh: 默认本地语音配置 · GPT-SoVITS v3
detail.en: Default local voice profile · GPT-SoVITS v3

description.zh: 为桌面带来角色表现。SpriteForge 运行时角色包，包含 KTX2 动画与行为、口型配置。
description.en: Bring character presence to your desktop. A SpriteForge runtime pack with KTX2 animation, behavior and mouth configuration.

detail.zh: 可选角色资源 · 不含创作工程
detail.en: Optional character pack · Runtime assets only

description.zh: 让桌面多一点氛围。提供壁纸效果、活动场景、字幕视觉与键盘音效等运行素材。
description.en: Set the atmosphere with wallpaper effects, activity scenes, subtitle visuals and keyboard sound effects.

detail.zh: 可选美术资源 · 独立于角色包安装

description.zh: 轻量，也有陪伴感。用于 Companion 的小型 WebP 头像资源，可独立于完整角色包使用。
description.en: A lighter kind of presence. Small WebP portraits for Companion, usable without the full character pack.

detail.zh: 轻量美术资源 · 无需完整壁纸角色包
detail.en: Lightweight portraits · No full character pack needed

description.zh: 探索另一种语音表现。提供 v2Pro 语音与说话人编码器权重，复用 v3 包的共享资源。
description.en: Explore an alternative voice profile. v2Pro voice and speaker-encoder weights reuse the v3 pack’s shared resources.

detail.zh: 实验性 · 需先安装 v3 语音包
detail.en: Experimental · Install the v3 voice pack first
